info.name: Rover-DR REST API - Differential Drive - Automated Tests
info.description: Validated Rover-DR API with motor safety, asynchronous command orchestration and initial differential-drive control. Automated Postman assertions added for HTTP status, JSON contract, response time, expected validation errors, hardware-disabled behavior, and safety gating of motion/gateway/lifecycle operations. Physical motion tests are skipped by default.
